artifact_schema.description: An object naming the integer whose trajectory is long, plus the trace commitment a challenger bisects against.

trace_root.description: Merkle root over the digests of every state the stepper visits, padded to trace_states.

trace_states.description: How many states the trace commits to. Fixed length, so two parties can bisect against each other at all.

statement: Exhibit an integer n in [1, 10^7) whose Collatz trajectory reaches 1 in at least 500 steps, and commit to the trajectory itself so a disagreement can be settled by executing one step rather than all of them.
